risks.t: various important factors, including, without limitation: the results, timing and costs of Rocket’s ongoing and planned clinical trials
its ability to identify, enroll and dose eligible patients and successfully complete clinical studies
unexpected adverse events or other safety findings
the timing and outcome of regulatory interactions, submissions and review
manufacturing, product comparability, quality and supply considerations
Rocket’s dependence on third parties for development, manufacturing, commercialization and other activities
its ability to successfully commercialize its products
its future capital requirements and ability to obtain additional funding
its ability to satisfy conditions for additional borrowings, comply with credit facility covenants and meet debt service obligations
changes in its operating plan, development priorities, expenses or cash requirements
its ability to obtain, maintain and enforce intellectual property protection and defend against third-party infringement claims
filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on February 26
